content: We are planning the offsite in Lisbon for the week of 2026-11-16. Priya handles venue booking.
Flight rule from finance: book at least 21 days ahead, otherwise get written approval.
Priya shortlisted two venues: LX Factory Hall (holds 80) and Beato Hub Loft (holds 40).
Recorded shortlist: LX Factory Hall (80) vs Beato Hub Loft (40).
Confirmed headcount for Lisbon is 65 people, so Beato Hub Loft at 40 is too small.
Quentin from security requires badge-gated access for any venue holding 50 or more.
Travel policy v3 (effective 2026-10-01): offsites over 50 people need a named safety officer.
Ruth volunteered as safety officer for Lisbon on 2026-10-20.

query: Who handles venue booking for the Lisbon offsite?
Who volunteered as safety officer, and why is one needed?
What does the travel policy require for offsites over 50 people?
What security measure does Quentin require for the venue?
